主要内容: On March 13, 2015, Insperity, Inc. announced that the board of directors had extended the deadline for stockholders to nominate directors to the board and propose other business for consideration at the 2015 annual meeting. The new deadline was set from March 13, 2015, until March 19, 2015. Any director nominations or proposals received by the company at or prior to the close of business on March 19, 2015, and otherwise complying with the company’s bylaws, may be submitted to stockholders at the 2015 annual meeting. This extension was made pursuant to the company’s bylaws.
